tickets.title: Assemble survivor administration packet
tickets.text: Assemble the core survivor administration packet for Galen Thimblefern, including the death certificate, 2016 will, and current household account list, to facilitate notifications to custodians, banks, and insurers following the death of Rhea Thimblefern.

tickets.title: Collect Paper Otter Publishing benefits documents
tickets.text: Collect the missing employer life insurance claim forms and 401(k) distribution paperwork for Rhea Thimblefern from Paper Otter Publishing, using the HR contact information provided by Galen Thimblefern.

tickets.title: Recover Teacup Comet Bank bill-pay access
tickets.text: Resolve the Teacup Comet Bank online bill-pay authentication issue for Galen Thimblefern, which is currently routing to Rhea Thimblefern's mobile number and blocking changes to household utility payees.

tickets.title: Reconcile Velvet Acorn Custody registration
tickets.text: Reconcile the Velvet Acorn Custody registration for the joint taxable account, resolving the discrepancy between the joint tenants status in custody records and the transfer-on-death designation in the estate binder for Galen Thimblefern.

tickets.title: Collect Tax Documents for Planning Review
tickets.text: Gather current income, withholding, charitable giving, estimated payment, and realized gain reports for Galen Thimblefern's survivor-year tax projection as requested by Nadia Pebblefizz of Pocket Lantern Tax.

tickets.title: Refresh retirement income model inputs
tickets.text: Update the retirement income model inputs for Galen Thimblefern by removing Rhea Thimblefern's employer medical premiums and income, and incorporating updated survivor income, Medicare premiums, cash reserves, and portfolio withdrawal assumptions.

tickets.title: Review Concentrated Position Exposure
tickets.text: Conduct a staged sale, charitable gifting, and tax-impact review for the Moonbadger Industrial Systems position held in Galen Thimblefern's taxable account to address his concerns about holding a large position during estate administration.
